note: OWNER_APPROVAL_RECEIPT — the fifth identity value of the package version model (RUNBOOK 3). Binds the owner's approval BY VALUE to one exact package id + MANIFEST.sha256. Lives outside the manifest's hash set to avoid self-reference; static_checks.py binds it by value equality. While status is PENDING-OWNER-APPROVAL the package is unapproved and no behavioral run is authorized. An amendment never edits this file in place: it produces a NEW package version with a fresh receipt.
